QuestInfo.name: Alfonse Green's Herb 2
QuestInfo.0: #bAlfonse Green#k in #bOrbis Cloud Park 1#k needs something...
QuestInfo.1: Alfonse Green wants Rosemary Flowers to give Elma the Housekeeper. Gather 5 Rosemary flowers.\n\n#i4022005##t4022005#  #b#c4022005# / 5#k
QuestInfo.2: You brought Rosemary Flowers to Alfonse Green.

0.0: Oh, I just had the most delightful Nependeath Juice. Elma makes the absolute best drinks! I would like to thank Elma with gift. Women like flowers, don't they?
0.1: Many herbs bloom with pretty flowers. Rosemary is known for its beautiful blue colors and soft charm... However, it's just not very easy to find! Can you help me?

yes.0: You can gather Rosemary Flowers from #bBlue Herbs#k. Bring me #b5 Rosemary Flowers#k. Please! I'll pay you handsomely.

no.0: Hmm... No, I suppose you wouldn't know much about flowers, would you?

1.0: Oh, lovely! Did you pick these yourself? Or did you buy them? Oh, it doesn't matter!

yes.0: I'm sure Elma with love these. Perhaps she'll love them enough to make me another glass of Nependeath Juice...

item.0: You still haven't collected all the #bRosemary Flowers#k? I suppose it's hard to get #b5 Flowers#k, since they are hard to spot. Even harder without Herbalism skill! I wonder if there are any on the market...?
